what: Tally error fallback is specified inside a trap that is registered after several planned-covered exit paths and checks $? after cleanup work
scenario_or_breakage: Early argv/ballot failures exit before the EXIT trap exists, and a cleanup body that runs rm before checking $? will see rm's status instead of the script's failing status, so TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS=tally-error is still missing on some non-zero exits
suggested_fix: Register the EXIT trap before argv validation with WORKDIR initialized empty, capture rc at the first line of cleanup, guard rm with [[ -n ${WORKDIR:-} ]], then emit tally-error when rc is non-zero and the success guard is false

what: The proposed per-voter KV helper does not account for the existing interleaved stdout contract including VOTER_PATHS_FILE
scenario_or_breakage: Replacing the current emit block with three per-slot helper calls either drops VOTER_PATHS_FILE or changes the byte-order the plan says must remain stable
suggested_fix: Keep VOTER_PATHS_FILE emission and current ordering inline, or make the helper block-level with all three voter records plus plan_voter_paths_file so it can reproduce the existing sequence exactly
